title: Creating the CPG Company of the Future
summary: P&G is creating the CPG company of the future, fundamentally reshaping how we operate to win with consumers.
body_markdown:
## We Are Actively Transforming Now To Lead The Next S-Curve Of Growth And Value Creation In Our Industry


P&G is uniquely positioned to lead this growth. We have the largest set of consumer data in the world, a unique set of innovation capabilities and technologies, some of the world’s most iconic and loved brands with big user bases, one of the largest creative brand-building ecosystems in the world, an industry-leading flexible and agile supply chain, very strong partnerships with retailers, and world-class talent and leadership.


P&G’s scale further amplifies these strengths with the access we have, globally, to leading innovation partners, media partners and suppliers — companies and institutions that want to work with us.


All of this positions P&G to lead this industry-defining transformation, fundamentally reshaping every aspect of how we operate.
